test_title: RRB Technician Grade III Official Paper (Held On: 27 Dec, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Two trains of length 120 m and 280 m are running towards each other on parallel lines at 42 km/h and 30 km/h, respectively. In how much time will they be clear of each other from the moment they meet?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

**Relative Speed** (Opposite Direction) = 42 + 30 = 72 km/h

Convert Speed to m/s: 72 × (5/18) = 20 m/s

**Total Distance** = Sum of lengths = 120 + 280 = 400 m

**Time Taken** = 400 ÷ 20 = 20 seconds

**∴ The correct answer is 20 sec.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/fa9fbc02a48e92b7ccc3a76b499036a0253e2fe44de29f2c2b6523eb88b11361.png] 

**Given:**

Length of Train 1 (L₁) = 120 m

Length of Train 2 (L₂) = 280 m

Speed of Train 1 (S₁) = 42 km/h

Speed of Train 2 (S₂) = 30 km/h

**Formula Used:**

Time = Total Distance ÷ Relative Speed

Relative Speed (Opposite) = S₁ + S₂

**Calculations:**

⇒ Total Distance = 120 + 280 = 400 m

⇒ Relative Speed = 42 + 30 = 72 km/h

⇒ Speed in m/s = 72 × (5/18) = 20 m/s

⇒ Time = 400 ÷ 20

⇒ Time = 20 seconds

**∴ The correct answer is 20 sec.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Relative Speed Rules

When two objects move in **opposite directions**, relative speed is S₁ + S₂. In **same direction**, relative speed is |S₁ − S₂|.

Unit Conversion

To convert **km/h to m/s**, multiply by 5/18. To convert **m/s to km/h**, multiply by 18/5.

Train Crossing Concepts

When a train crosses another train or a bridge, total distance is the **sum of their lengths**. When crossing a pole or a person, distance equals the **train's length** only.</p
